schema.name: ocean_room_deliveries
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ocean_room_deliveries"(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(workspace_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),room_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(room_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    root_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(root_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),to_task_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(to_task_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    recipient_bot_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(recipient_bot_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),cause_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(cause_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    request_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(request_key AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),message_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(message_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    from_task_id TEXT CHECK(from_task_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(from_task_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),source_turn_id TEXT CHECK(source_turn_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(source_turn_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),sender_bot_id TEXT CHECK(sender_bot_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(sender_bot_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('start','message','delegate','result')),
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq>=1),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),
    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 31),source_attempt_id TEXT CHECK(source_attempt_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(source_attempt_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','claimed','consumed','held')),
    UNIQUE(request_key,position),UNIQUE(request_key,recipient_bot_id),UNIQUE(to_task_id,message_id),
    CHECK((kind='start' AND cause_id=root_id AND from_task_id IS NULL AND source_turn_id IS NULL AND sender_bot_id IS NULL AND source_attempt_id IS NULL)
      OR (kind IN ('message','delegate','result') AND position=0 AND from_task_id IS NOT NULL
        AND source_turn_id IS NOT NULL AND sender_bot_id IS NOT NULL AND source_attempt_id IS NOT NULL)),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,to_task_id) REFERENCES ocean_room_tasks(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,from_task_id) REFERENCES ocean_room_tasks(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(room_id,source_turn_id) REFERENCES ocean_chat_turns(room_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(room_id,seq,message_id) REFERENCES ocean_messages(room_id,seq,id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    FOREIGN KEY(request_key) REFERENCES ocean_receipts(request_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  ) STRICT

schema.name: ocean_room_tasks
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ocean_room_tasks(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(workspace_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    room_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(room_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    root_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(root_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),parent_id TEXT CHECK(parent_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(parent_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),assignee_bot_id TEXT CHECK(assignee_bot_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(assignee_bot_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ready','waiting','paused','completed','stopped')),
    version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
    last_delivery_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(last_delivery_seq>=0),waiting_child_id TEXT CHECK(waiting_child_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(waiting_child_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    root_payload TEXT,
    UNIQUE(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id),
    CHECK((id=root_id AND parent_id IS NULL AND assignee_bot_id IS NULL
      AND waiting_child_id IS NULL AND last_delivery_seq=0 AND root_payload IS NOT NULL
      AND json_valid(root_payload))
      OR (id<>root_id AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id<>id AND assignee_bot_id IS NOT NULL
      AND root_payload IS NULL AND ((status='waiting')=(waiting_child_id IS NOT NULL)))),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id) REFERENCES ocean_rooms(workspace_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,assignee_bot_id) REFERENCES ocean_bots(workspace_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,root_id) REFERENCES ocean_room_tasks(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,parent_id) REFERENCES ocean_room_tasks(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id),
    FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,waiting_child_id) REFERENCES ocean_room_tasks(workspace_id,room_id,root_id,id)
  ) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER ocean_addressed_message BEFORE INSERT ON ocean_messages
  WHEN NEW.author='bot' AND NEW.author_bot_id<>NEW.target_bot_id AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM ocean_room_deliveries d JOIN ocean_chat_turns c ON c.id=d.source_turn_id
    JOIN ocean_room_deliveries i ON i.id=d.cause_id
    WHERE d.message_id=NEW.id AND d.seq=NEW.seq AND d.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND d.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND d.sender_bot_id=NEW.author_bot_id
      AND d.recipient_bot_id=NEW.target_bot_id AND d.source_turn_id=NEW.turn_id
      AND d.kind IN ('message','delegate')
      AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.roomDelivery.deliveryId')=i.id
      AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.roomDelivery.taskId')=d.from_task_id
      AND i.to_task_id=d.from_task_id AND i.root_id=d.root_id)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'addressed message requires delivery'); END

schema.name: ocean_room_delivery_target
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ocean_room_delivery_target BEFORE INSERT ON ocean_room_deliveries
    WHEN (NEW.kind<>'result' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_room_tasks t WHERE t.id=NEW.to_task_id
    AND t.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND t.room_id=NEW.room_id AND t.root_id=NEW.root_id
    AND t.assignee_bot_id=NEW.recipient_bot_id
    AND t.parent_id=CASE WHEN NEW.kind='start' THEN NEW.root_id ELSE NEW.from_task_id END)
    OR (NEW.kind<>'start' AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM ocean_room_tasks s JOIN ocean_chat_turns c ON c.id=NEW.source_turn_id
      JOIN ocean_room_deliveries i ON i.id=NEW.cause_id
      WHERE s.id=NEW.from_task_id AND s.assignee_bot_id=NEW.sender_bot_id
        AND s.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND s.room_id=NEW.room_id AND s.root_id=NEW.root_id
        AND c.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND c.room_id=NEW.room_id
        AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.roomDelivery.taskId')=s.id
        AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.roomDelivery.deliveryId')=i.id
        AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.bot.id')=NEW.sender_bot_id
        AND i.to_task_id=s.id AND i.root_id=NEW.root_id)))) OR (NEW.kind='result' AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM ocean_room_deliveries edge
      JOIN ocean_room_tasks p ON p.id=edge.from_task_id
      JOIN ocean_room_tasks b ON b.id=edge.to_task_id
      JOIN ocean_chat_turns yielded ON yielded.id=edge.source_turn_id
      JOIN ocean_chat_turns final ON final.id=NEW.source_turn_id
      JOIN ocean_room_deliveries input ON input.id=json_extract(final.payload,'$.roomDelivery.deliveryId')
      JOIN ocean_messages m ON m.id=NEW.message_id
      WHERE edge.id=NEW.cause_id AND edge.kind='delegate' AND edge.root_id=NEW.root_id
      AND p.id=NEW.to_task_id AND p.waiting_child_id=b.id AND p.status='waiting'
      AND b.id=NEW.from_task_id AND b.status='completed' AND b.parent_id=p.id AND b.assignee_bot_id=NEW.sender_bot_id
      AND p.assignee_bot_id=NEW.recipient_bot_id AND b.root_id=p.root_id AND b.root_id=NEW.root_id
      AND p.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND p.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND b.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND b.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND edge.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND edge.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND yielded.status='completed' AND json_extract(yielded.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition')='yielded'
      AND json_extract(yielded.payload,'$.roomHandoff.deliveryId')=edge.id
      AND json_extract(yielded.payload,'$.roomHandoff.childTaskId')=b.id
      AND json_extract(final.payload,'$.roomDelivery.taskId')=b.id
      AND final.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND final.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND input.to_task_id=b.id AND input.root_id=b.root_id AND input.state='consumed'
      AND m.id='reply_'||final.id AND m.seq=NEW.seq AND m.turn_id=final.id
      AND m.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND m.room_id=NEW.room_id
      AND m.author='bot' AND m.author_bot_id=b.assignee_bot_id AND m.target_bot_id=b.assignee_bot_id
      AND m.body=json_extract(final.payload,'$.text') AND final.status='completed'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.aggregate_id=final.task_run_id AND e.type='task_run.succeeded'
        AND e.sequence=(SELECT max(sequence) FROM events WHERE aggregate_id=final.task_run_id)
        AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.attemptId')=NEW.source_attempt_id
        AND e.causation_id='cm_'||final.task_run_id||'_Complete_'||(json_extract(final.payload,'$.preparedVersion')+1))
      AND json_extract(final.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition') IS NULL))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid room delivery lineage'); END

schema.name: ocean_room_slice_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ocean_room_slice_insert BEFORE INSERT ON ocean_chat_turns
    WHEN (json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery') IS NOT NULL AND (
      json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery') IS NOT 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery'))<>3
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery') WHERE key NOT IN ('version','taskId','deliveryId'))
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.version') IS NOT 'integer'
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.version') IS NOT 1
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.taskId') IS NOT 'text'
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.deliveryId') IS NOT 'text'))
    OR (json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff') IS NOT NULL AND (
      json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff') IS NOT 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff'))<>8
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff') WHERE key NOT IN ('version','turnId','taskRunId','attemptId','callId','childTaskId','deliveryId','expectedRunVersion'))
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.expectedRunVersion') IS NOT 'integer'
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.expectedRunVersion') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740990
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.callId') IS NOT 'text'
      OR length(CAST(json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.callId') AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512
      OR NEW.status NOT IN ('dispatching','uncertain','completed')
      OR (NEW.status='completed' AND json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition') IS NOT 'yielded')
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.version') IS NOT 'integer'
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.version') IS NOT 1
      OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.version') IS NOT 'integer'
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.version') IS NOT 1
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.turnId') IS NOT NEW.id
      OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.taskRunId') IS NOT NEW.task_run_id
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_room_deliveries d JOIN ocean_room_tasks t ON t.id=d.from_task_id
        WHERE d.id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.deliveryId') AND d.kind='delegate'
        AND d.source_turn_id=NEW.id AND d.source_attempt_id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.attemptId')
        AND d.to_task_id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff.childTaskId')
        AND d.from_task_id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.taskId')
        AND d.cause_id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery.deliveryId'))))
      OR (json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomDelivery') IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status='completed'
        AND json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition') IS NULL AND (
          json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff') IS NOT NULL
          OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.preparedVersion') IS NOT 'integer'
          OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.preparedVersion')<1
          OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.text') IS NOT 'text'
          OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.stopReason') NOT IN ('end_turn','max_tokens')
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_chat_turns old WHERE old.id=NEW.id
            AND old.status IN ('prepared','completed') AND old.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND old.room_id=NEW.room_id
            AND old.task_run_id=NEW.task_run_id AND json_extract(old.payload,'$.text')=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.text')
            AND json_extract(old.payload,'$.preparedVersion')=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.preparedVersion')
            AND json_extract(old.payload,'$.stopReason')=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.stopReason'))
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.aggregate_id=NEW.task_run_id AND e.type='task_run.succeeded'
            AND e.sequence=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.preparedVersion')+1
            AND e.sequence=(SELECT max(sequence) FROM events WHERE aggregate_id=NEW.task_run_id))
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ocean_messages m WHERE m.id='reply_'||NEW.id AND m.turn_id=NEW.id
            AND m.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND m.room_id=NEW.room_id AND m.seq>json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.readThroughSeq')
            AND m.author='bot' AND m.author_bot_id=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.bot.id') AND m.target_bot_id=m.author_bot_id
            AND m.body=json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.text'))))
      OR (json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition') IS NOT NULL AND (
        json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.roomSliceDisposition') IS NOT 'yielded' OR NEW.status IS NOT 'completed'
        OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.roomHandoff') IS NULL OR json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.text') IS NOT ''
        OR json_type(NEW.payload,'$.preparedVersion') IS NOT 'null'))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid room slice'); END
